public_health_question.v: One year after a chemical fire in Winnebago County, Illinois, what ongoing mental and physical health symptoms and community needs do residents report?

ev.q: One year after the fire, IDPH and WCHD invited ATSDR to conduct a follow-up ACE investigation to assess ongoing health impacts.
Follow-Up Assessment 1 Year After a Chemical Exposure Investigation
In the follow-up survey, 39% (265) of respondents reported new or worsening mental health symptoms since the fire
59% (400) reported new or worsening physical health symptoms
